episode_row: heartbeat false Healthchecks failures (cold-wake predict; polling sleep)

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): keep heartbeat fresh during long predictions
commits.body:
The run_and_pick cascade can take 5-6 min on cold-start wakes (data
refresh + model load + 270-batter predictions). No heartbeat was
written during that window, so scripts/check_heartbeat.py false-fired
every cold wake: first Phase B cron run at 13:15 ET today reported
"running state but timestamp 302s old (>300s)" and pinged /fail to HC,
then /success at 13:20 when the prediction finished and the sleeping
heartbeat landed. Spurious alert.

heartbeat_watchdog is a context manager that spawns a daemon thread
writing state=RUNNING heartbeats + firing sd_notify watchdog pings
every 60s while its body runs. Wrapping run_and_pick in run_single_check
and _refresh_pick_at_fallback keeps the heartbeat age bounded
(~60s max) regardless of total prediction duration.

Tests in tests/test_heartbeat.py: refresh-during-block + quiet-after-exit.
Full suite 554 passed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): keep heartbeat fresh during result-polling sleep
commits.body:
Bug: run_result_polling's inter-iteration 15-min sleep had no heartbeat
refresh. check_heartbeat.py's 5-min 'running' threshold fires /fail to HC
at minutes 5 and 10 of every 15-min cycle, producing ~2-3 false alerts per
polling iteration. Observed live today 2026-04-22 starting 19:05 ET when
the scheduler entered result_polling for the Laureano+Henderson slate —
12 stale=True log entries in 2 hours before discovery via HC log review.

This is the same heartbeat-gap class as the prediction-loop bug fixed
earlier (commit 0830ef4), but in a different function. The earlier
heartbeat_watchdog wrap only covered run_and_pick inside run_single_check.
run_result_polling's main loop has its own time.sleep that was uncovered.

Fix: new _poll_interval_sleep(heartbeat_path, seconds) helper that wraps
the sleep with heartbeat_watchdog when a path is given, plain sleep
otherwise. Called from run_result_polling's while-loop sleep.

2 tests in TestPollIntervalSleep: no-path still sleeps, path-given refreshes
heartbeat during sleep. Full suite: 561 passed (was 559).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
